keybindprofilesplus.overview.title: Key Binds
keybindprofilesplus.overview.summary: Showing %s of %s - %s from mods - %s not bound

keybindprofilesplus.overview.tooltip.sco: Click the name to change when this key counts as in use
keybindprofilesplus.scope.non_spectator: during play, not in Spectator mode
keybindprofilesplus.scope.screen_only: only while a screen is open
keybindprofilesplus.scope.situational: only in a special situation (never a conflict)
keybindprofilesplus.conflict.shared: On the same key, but not a conflict (only acts in a special situation):
keybindprofilesplus.conflict.reason.debu: both are F3 combinations on this key
keybindprofilesplus.conflict.reason.crea: both are used in Creative mode
keybindprofilesplus.conflict.reason.spec: both are used in Spectator mode
keybindprofilesplus.conflict.reason.scre: one works during play, the other only in screens
keybindprofilesplus.conflict.reason.exte: that mod uses the same key
that mod uses the same key in another situation
keybindprofilesplus.external.readonly: Read-only: read from %s. Change it in that mod.
keybindprofilesplus.external.inactive: This Meteor profile is not the one in use
keybindprofilesplus.external.editable: Managed by that mod; saved by it in %s
keybindprofilesplus.no_servers: No rules: this profile is never applied automatically
keybindprofilesplus.server.help: Rules: an address (play.example.org), a host for any port and its subdomains (example.org), a wildcard (*.example.org), singleplayer, lan, realms, or * for anywhere. The most specific rule wins.
keybindprofilesplus.server.auto_switch_t: When you join a world or server, apply the profile whose rule matches it.
keybindprofilesplus.server.rule.host: This host on any port, and its subdomains
keybindprofilesplus.rules.title: Auto-Switch Rules
keybindprofilesplus.rules.priority: When several rules match, the most specific one wins
keybindprofilesplus.settings.title: KeyBind Profiles+ Settings
keybindprofilesplus.settings.replace_key: Replace the vanilla Key Binds screen

ON: Options -> Controls -> Key Binds opens this mod's screen, where keys can be changed and every key shows its source mod and its conflicts. OFF: the vanilla screen is kept, with this mod's buttons and conflict markers added to it.
keybindprofilesplus.settings.default_pro: The profile to go back to when you leave a world or server, if "Back to default when leaving" is on.
keybindprofilesplus.settings.return_to_d: When you leave a world or server, apply the default profile again.
keybindprofilesplus.share.copy.tooltip: Copies the selected profile to the clipboard as one line of text (a share code). Anyone can turn it back into the profile with Import. Hotkey and server rules are not included.
keybindprofilesplus.share.paste_prompt: Paste a share code here (it starts with KBP1-)
keybindprofilesplus.share.error.not_a_co: This is not a share code (it should start with KBP1-)
keybindprofilesplus.share.error.corrupte: The share code is damaged or incomplete
keybindprofilesplus.share.error.unsuppor: This share code is from a newer version of the mod
keybindprofilesplus.share.error.invalid_: The share code does not contain a usable profile
keybindprofilesplus.import.title: Import a Profile
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.keybindpr: Save, compare, share and instantly switch whole sets of key bindings, optionally together with chosen game settings. Its Key Binds screen shows which mod every key comes from, marks real conflicts, supports Ctrl/Shift/Alt combinations and also edits the hotkeys of Meteor Client, MaLiLib mods and Inventory Profiles Next. Based on KeyBindProfiles by sawiq_.
